name: rE
expr: max(ceil((2 * dT + sl + 2 * rd + pt / 2) / g), floor(ribTarget / g))

name: kMin
expr: max(ts + legClear + ts / 2, ts + pt + dT + tabW / 2 + clr + rd)

name: webN
expr: min(sqrt(max(0 mm, g / 2 - aN) * max(0 mm, g / 2 - aN) + (eN - dN) * (eN - dN)), sqrt((g / 2 - aN + rd) * (g / 2 - aN + rd) + (eN - dN) * (eN - dN)) - rd) - hd / 2

name: webS
expr: min(g / 2 - hd / 2 - pt, sqrt((g / 2 - tabW / 2 + e1) * (g / 2 - tabW / 2 + e1) + (g / 2 - pt - e1) * (g / 2 - pt - e1)) - rd - hd / 2)

name: pitch
expr: max(tabStep, xt0, yt0, ribStep - 2 * dT, yr0 - dT - ts, Wd - ts - yrL - dT, xr0 - dT - ts, L - ts - xrL - dT)

name: pocketOk
expr: pt - tabLt >= 3 mm && ts - tabLs >= 3 mm && tabLt >= pt / 2 && tabLs >= ts / 2

name: reliefOk
expr: sw > 4 * rd && sl > 4 * rd && rd >= kerf

name: ribsOk
expr: mX >= 1 && mY >= 1 && ribStep - 2 * dT - sl - 2 * rd >= pt / 2

name: weld pockets: tabs 50 to 75 % into the plate, at least 3 mm left
webs at the notches and the skirt holes at least half the plate
reliefs fit their slots and are at least the kerf
ribs clear the legs, two tabs fit between crossings
Legs: cut length legLen (measured with the top)
Rails, long: cut length railLenX (measured with the ribs across)
Rails, short: cut length railLenY (measured with the ribs along)
sys
label: System
description: System 16: 16 mm holes on a 50 mm grid, 12 mm top, 100 mm deep, 10 mm skirts and ribs. System 28: 28 mm holes on a 100 mm grid, 25 mm top, 200 mm deep, 20 mm skirts and ribs

name: ribTarget
label: Rib spacing
description: Ribs at most this far apart where the grid and the tabs allow, on the lines between the holes

name: tabTarget
label: Tab spacing
description: Tabs along the skirts at most this far apart, between two holes

name: tabPct
label: Tab depth
description: How far a tab reaches into the plate it enters, in % of that plate; at least 3 mm is left as the pocket for the plug weld

name: clr
label: Fit clearance
description: Clearance per side between a tab and its slot

name: kerf
label: Laser kerf
description: Width of the laser's cut: the corner reliefs get this radius, at least 0.5 mm. The outlines are nominal; the cutter compensates the kerf

name: frame
label: Base
description: Only the block (for trestles), four legs on foot plates, or legs joined by rails near the floor

name: tableH
label: Working height
description: Height of the top surface above the floor, with legs

name: profile
label: Tube
description: Square hollow section of the legs and rails (EN 10219-2): width x width x wall in mm

title: Welding table
description: A system welding table (16 mm or 28 mm holes) to laser cut and MIG weld: a perforated top, perforated skirts on all four edges and half-lapped ribs, every plate joint tab and slot with T-bone and dogbone reliefs and tabs that stop short of the surface, so the plug welds grind flush; legs and rails of square tube from a table of EN 10219 sizes. Export the plates with File > Export..., DXF or SVG with the face set "Cut sheet"; the sets Legs and Rails and the assertions (assert.list) give the tube cut list.
